counterfactual.change: Same 3-step scenario with only dt reduced from 0.0287473 to 0.001; free-flight energy stays ~971.8 J and no rule is violated, showing the gain is a large-dt integration/substep error.

explanation: Single e=1 body starts 0.095 below ceiling moving up at ~40.5 m/s and bounces elastically within step 1. Afterwards it is in free fall (touching_pairs empty, controller_work 0) yet vy grows by ~1.69 m/s per 0.0287 s step (-40.74 to -42.43 to -44.12), i.e. ~59 m/s2 vs declared gravity 9.81, so kinetic + total energy grows ~60 J/step from 971.9 to 1092.7 J. Small-dt rerun removes the gain, pointing to over-application of gravity across substeps (40-43 substeps/step) at large dt.
vision_note: A single blue circle starts just below the top boundary and falls straight down through an empty arena. Its drop distance grows sharply by step 3 to mid-height, showing rapid downward acceleration in free fall with no other bodies or forces visible.
